root_idea.summary: The root centers on encountering a hard obstruction that halts progress.
root_idea.development: Its core image is a digger reaching a hard layer of earth and having to stop. This develops into meanings of blocked or unsuccessful pursuit, giving little and then stopping, turning someone or something back, and related forms of resistance or setback.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَكْدَى.

senses.definition: To give little and then stop; to withhold or cut off one's giving.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage at 53:34, it describes a person who gives only a small amount and then ceases giving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard layer or mass of earth encountered while digging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: الكُدَايَةُ is reported as a variant; reaching this hard material causes digging to stop.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fail in pursuing or attaining an objective when effort is blocked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the digger whose progress is stopped by a hard layer of earth; distinct from the Quranic application to giving little and stopping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn someone back from something or prevent him from proceeding toward it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV usage expressing removal or turning back from an intended object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land that is slow or resistant to yield.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description linked to the obstruction or resistance associated with a hard layer of earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cold or frost that damages crops, and to set crops back into the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source reports the noun with hamz and notes that the hamz may be secondary rather than original.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a dog: to develop digestive disorder after drinking milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage attributed to al-Farrāʾ and explicitly restricted to this animal-and-milk context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place name, possibly connected with the hard-ground meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The etymological connection is reported tentatively rather than asserted as certain.

cautions: No Lane primary entry was supplied for this root; the Quranic sense is supported by the unique Mufradat evidence, while the broader classical branches are drawn from the supplied Mufradat and Maqayis evidence.
The crop-related form كَادِئَةٌ is reported with possible secondary hamz and is kept separate from the Quranic Form IV verb أَكْدَى.
